speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Cholangiocarcinoma. REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_CTA. The history of significant weight loss, pruritus, and pale stools combined with your age and smoking history is highly suggestive of a biliary malignancy, not appendicitis. Please undergo an urgent CT angiogram to visualize the bile ducts and liver.
